source_name: EU Generalised Scheme of Preferences — proof of origin, and the Registered Exporter (REX) system

chunks.locator: Generalised Scheme of Preferences (GSP) — proof of origin
chunks.text: After 30 June 2020, the proof of origin to claim preferential tariff treatment under the GSP is a statement on origin issued by exporters who are registered in the beneficiary country in the Registered Exporter System (REX).
The Registered Exporter (REX) system is a system that allows for the certification of the origin of goods based on the self-certification principle.

chunks.locator: Registered Exporter (REX) system — who may make out a statement on origin
chunks.text: To be allowed to make out a statement on origin, the exporter must be a 'registered exporter' in the database of their national competent authorities.

requirements.title: Proof of origin for the consignment
requirements.what_is_required: Evidence of where these goods originate. If you intend to claim preferential tariff treatment under the EU's Generalised Scheme of Preferences, the accepted proof of origin is a statement on origin made out by an exporter registered in the REX system — not a chamber-issued certificate of origin.
requirements.why_required: Origin decides the duty rate applied at import. Since 30 June 2020 the EU accepts a REX statement on origin as the proof for GSP preference. A Certificate of Origin issued by a chamber of commerce still evidences origin for general purposes, but it is not the document that claims GSP preference.
requirements.when_it_applies: Applies to every consignment for customs purposes, and specifically where preferential tariff treatment under the GSP is to be claimed.
satisfying_evidence: A statement on origin from an exporter registered in the REX system, made on the invoice or another commercial document, where GSP preference is claimed
A Certificate of Origin evidencing the country of origin of the goods
Consistent country of origin across the shipment documents
needed_document_or_info: Certificate of Origin, or the statement on origin text if you are REX-registered
Your REX registration number, if you intend to claim GSP preference

checks.description: A Certificate of Origin has been provided for this case
